pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavatā paṭikkhittaṃ suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpetun ti te thokaṃ yeva odātaṃ ante ādiyitvā tath' eva suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.3: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te . . . vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū thokaṃ yeva odātaṃ ante ādiyitvā tath' eva suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.5: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.6: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave thokaṃ yeva odātaṃ ante ādiyitvā tath' eva suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ santhataṃ kārāpethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.9: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā thokaṃ yeva . . . santhataṃ kārāpessatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.10: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--;
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.11: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.12.1: navaṃ pana bhikkhunā santhataṃ kārayamānena dve bhāgā suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ ādātabbā tatiyaṃ odātānaṃ catutthaṃ gocariyānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:1.13: anādā ce bhikkhu dve bhāge suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ tatiyaṃ odātānaṃ catutthaṃ gocariyānaṃ navaṃ santhataṃ kārāpeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.13: anādā ce bhikkhu dve bhāge suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ tatiyaṃ odātānaṃ catutthaṃ gocariyānan ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.14: anādiyitvā tulaṃ odātānaṃ tulaṃ gocariyānaṃ navaṃ santhataṃ karoti vā kārāpeti vā, payoge dukkaṭaṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.19: idaṃ me bhante santhataṃ anādiyitvā tulaṃ odātānaṃ tulaṃ gocariyānaṃ kārāpitaṃ nissaggiyaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.31: tulaṃ odātānaṃ tulaṃ gocariyānaṃ ādiyitvā karoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.32: bahutaraṃ odātānaṃ bahutaraṃ gocariyānaṃ ādiyitvā karoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.33: suddhaṃ odātānaṃ suddhaṃ gocariyānaṃ ādiyitvā karoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np13:2.34: vitānaṃ vā bhummattharaṇaṃ vā sāṇipākāraṃ vā bhisiṃ vā bimbohanaṃ vā karoti,
